name: Brand Book Builder
purpose: Compile validated verbal identity and visual/identity system canon into one coherent, usable brand manual - without reopening upstream decisions or inventing rules to fill compilation gaps.
triggers: both verbal identity artifacts and identity system artifacts exist for the same brand
a client-facing or operational brand book/manual is needed
the brand workflow has reached the point where verbal and visual identity both feed a single compiled artifact
non_triggers: brand discovery, strategy, voice, or visual-system derivation
fixing a poor or thin upstream artifact by inventing better rules while compiling
auditing existing production copy/design against canon
only one of verbal or visual canon exists for the brand
quality_gates: every rule in BRAND_BOOK.md traces to one of the 6 source artifacts, none invented
no two sections state contradictory rules without an explicit flagged note
the verbal/visual coherence check has run and findings are stated in RUN_RESULT.unresolved
BRAND_BOOK_ASSET_CHECKLIST.md lists every missing example and every coherence gap
the book passes the usability test without requiring upstream chat context
stop_conditions: all three required artifacts produced, coherence check run, usability test passed -> COMPLETE
one or more of the 6 required upstream artifacts missing -> BLOCKED, name which artifact(s) and owning skill
coherence gap serious enough to misrepresent the brand as aligned -> PARTIAL, book still produced with gap flagged
never present a coherence gap as resolved or publish an untraceable rule
